title: onobrychis supina f. intermedia
intro: Onobrychis supina f. intermedia, commonly known as intermediate narrowleaf bird's foot trefoil, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and traditional uses in folk medicine, particularly in Eastern Europe and Asia. Onobrychis supina f. intermedia is valued for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and antispasmodic effects.
